goals.name: Connection Cadence — quarterly regional outing + mover-manager roundtables (bundles the 5 eNPS asks)
goals.assessment: Two halves. The manager-roundtable half now has a locked date: the first BM strategy session of the quarter runs Thursday 9/3 at 2:30 PM, all 10 branch managers across both regions, on a redesigned pair-first agenda — managers brief each other in pairs, then present their partner's notes to the room, with leadership split into two leads and two silent observers. It is built directly against the failure mode these sessions have had: managers vocal offline and silent in the room, handing problems up instead of solving them. Blueprint is published. Final details confirm today so the delegation-board pulse can go out ahead of Thursday. On the events half, budget is closed at $75 per person and options and candidate dates are compiled across 5 regions and 37 attendees; the choice messaging goes out by end of week to lock dates in September or early October.

No regional event dates locked yet — choice messaging goes out by EOW to start setting September / early October dates

goals.name: Scrum Accountability Part 3 — Huddle Grading + Value Tracking
goals.assessment: The certification cohort ran end to end today. Eleven mock boards read against rubric v1.5: **eight managers certified** — Alex Tran 58/60, Rance Pope 56, Nick Dagel 54, and Frank Williams, Chris Anderson, Daniel Behseresht, Calvin Hughes and Joel Villatoro at 52 — against a planted baseline of 29/60. Three sit on attempt 1 of 2 pending rework (Garrison Cobe 50, Hector Zavala 50, Cameron Klepac 40) and four were extended to 9/1 (Jespah Lara, Lukas Konrad, Dustin Street, Sergio Buenrostro). All five CTXH BMs who sat it passed. Weekly live maintenance reads also started: Leander 54/60 (pass, both managers clear) and San Antonio 50/60. Three rubric rulings shipped today and are codified across the skill, the Manager Reference Sheet, the Training Module, the Fix-It Checklist and both glossaries: auto-generated damage claim pulses are exempt from the duplicates criterion; mock reads grade dates against the trainee's own timeline rather than the RM's read date; and every manager gets two attempts with feedback in between. Individual readouts now require a note on every criterion scoring under 5, no matter how high the total.
blockers: 4 managers extended to 9/1 — Jespah Lara, Lukas Konrad, Dustin Street, Sergio Buenrostro; no attempts consumed
3 managers on attempt 1 awaiting rework and re-score — Garrison Cobe, Hector Zavala, Cameron Klepac
Live-read cadence still unsettled: whether the score is the pre-fix or post-fix read is parked until the whole cohort is certified
Not one of the 11 boards had all 3 QG Live pulses updated — the single best thing to reinforce with the whole group
Mock instructions never say whether to work the board in scenario or in real time; the cohort split on it and each board needed a judgment call
